SUBJECT (RIGHT panel — large head):
12-year-old Latino boy, ~145cm, slim youthful build. Warm light-brown tan skin, smooth childlike complexion, a couple of tiny natural beauty marks on the left cheek. Round-oval face, soft jaw, small rounded chin, full youthful cheeks. Dark brown almond eyes, calm neutral gaze, thick dark eyebrows with a small natural gap. Straight small nose, full lips, neutral resting expression. Clean face, no facial hair. Hair: thick dense black tight curls/coils, medium volume on top, messy natural crown, curls falling slightly over the forehead, shorter at the temples. Small silver hoop in left ear, thin delicate silver chain at the collar.
LEFT panel — OUTFIT ONLY, ghost-mannequin (invisible body, garments floating/styled as worn, no person, no head):
Modern young-adult streetwear sized for a ~20-year-old, ~180cm frame. Oversized heavyweight cotton hoodie (400gsm) as the hero piece — electric cobalt, boxy cut, slightly cropped hem, hood up-collar structure visible, drawstrings uneven. Centered chest print: "HIGGS" wordmark in acid chartreuse #d1ef17, bold sans, screen-print sitting in the weave (not glossy). Worn over a fitted metallic silver-grey baselayer poking out at cuffs and hem. Baggy low-slung cargo jeans, faded indigo, oversized pockets, contrast stitching. Chunky white-and-chartreuse dad sneakers, thick treaded gum-tinted soles, broken-in. Accessories minimal: matte-black crossbody sling with reflective trim, over-ear headphones styled around the collar, chrome ball-chain + thin chartreuse cord choker, two stacked chrome rings, carabiner + keys clipped to a cargo loop. Overall palette: saturated and clean — cobalt-led with crisp chartreuse pops, chrome accents, no muddy tones.

Character-sheet split composition. LEFT = full outfit in WIDE shot, ghost-mannequin style, no body. RIGHT = large head-and-shoulders close-up. Clear vertical divide.

SCENE CONTEXT A character reference for the mother of the young man in reference 1. She must read instantly as his mother — same heritage and facial DNA, older generation — dressed in comfortable home clothes for cooking (wardrobe per references 2, 3, 4). All three shots are taken in a clean studio on a neutral light-grey cyclorama: a tight face portrait, a full-length front view, and a full-length back view.
ACTIVE REFERENCES Ref 1 = son's face (identity/resemblance source). Refs 2, 3, 4 = homewear cooking wardrobe source (clothing only, NOT the kitchen environment).
CHARACTER ANCHORS (identity lock — family resemblance to the son) Woman, around 50–55. Warm olive-tan skin with the same undertone as the son, mixed Latino–Southeast-Asian heritage. Dark hair with natural curl and a few soft grey strands, mid-length, loosely pulled back with curls framing the face. Inherited facial structure straight from the son: warm dark-brown almond-shaped eyes with the same spacing and slight downturn, the same broad nose with a rounded tip, full lips, soft rounded cheeks, strong defined dark brows, the same calm steady gaze. The resemblance must be unmistakable — clearly mother and son. A neat, fine, well-groomed thin mustache along the upper lip — light, sparse, tidy and intentional, NOT thick, NOT bushy or voluminous. Small silver hoop earring and a tiny stud, like the son. Warm composed expression, neutral lips.
Realistic skin texture, age-appropriate: natural lived-in skin with visible fine pores and soft sheen, a few light horizontal forehead lines and fine wrinkles under the eyes, plus faint soft smile lines. The wrinkles read clearly but stay shallow and gentle — fine and natural, NOT deep, NOT heavy or harsh. Minimal makeup, real human skin, no plastic or over-smoothed retouching. 100% consistent across all three shots.
WARDROBE (homewear for cooking, per refs 2–4) Soft, relaxed domestic clothing in warm natural tones: a light linen or cotton camp-collar shirt or a white long-sleeve tee with sleeves rolled to the forearm, layered under a mid-length cotton/linen kitchen apron in beige, clay, or muted olive, tied at the waist with soft strings. Relaxed comfortable trousers below in a warm neutral tone. Soft, lived-in, gently creased fabrics. Consistent outfit across the full-length front and back shots.
SHOT 1 — FACE PORTRAIT (close-up) Framing: tight close-up, head and shoulders, face fully readable and centered. Optics: 29° diagonal field of view, short telephoto portrait lens character, camera 4 m back, flattering stable proportions, subject razor-sharp, skin texture and fine wrinkles clearly resolved. Camera: eye-level, locked static.
SHOT 2 — FULL-LENGTH FRONT Framing: full figure head to feet, standing relaxed and facing camera, arms natural at sides, the home cooking outfit fully readable. Optics: 47° standard normal lens character, camera 4–5 m back, zero distortion, straight rectilinear edges, deep focus head to hem. Camera: eye-level, locked static, full body centered with even margins.
SHOT 3 — FULL-LENGTH BACK Framing: full figure from directly behind, same standing pose, showing the back of the shirt, apron ties, hair, and trousers. Optics: same 47° standard normal lens, same distance and height as Shot 2 for matched scale. Camera: eye-level, locked static, dead-on rear view.
BACKGROUND All three shots on a clean, seamless neutral light-grey cyclorama — smooth infinity-wall studio sweep with no visible corners, floor seam, or horizon line. No kitchen, no props, no environment. Background stays flat neutral grey across all three frames.
LIGHTING Even soft studio softbox key from the front-upper, broad and gentle, light wraparound fill, smooth shadowless gradient on the grey cyclorama, soft contact shadow at the feet in the full-length shots. For the portrait, the same soft key so the face, fine mustache and shallow wrinkles read clearly without harsh shadow. Natural warm skin rendering, no harsh speculars.
PHYSICS & MATERIAL Realistic human skin with fine pores, soft sheen, and shallow natural wrinkles on the forehead and under the eyes. Soft linen and cotton with natural folds and light creases, apron fabric draping with real weight, hair holding natural curl with slight movement, jewelry sitting with weight. Grounded, photoreal studio texture, no over-smoothing.
POSITIVE LOCKS The woman is clearly the mother of the young man in ref 1 — shared olive-tan skin, dark curly hair, brown almond eyes, broad rounded nose, and family likeness make the relationship obvious. Mustache stays fine, neat and well-groomed, never thick or bushy. Skin is realistic with shallow, non-deep forehead and under-eye wrinkles. Same face, hair and wardrobe consistent across all three images (outfit matched in the two full-length shots). Neutral light-grey cyclorama studio background in every shot. Single subject, no extra people, no text overlays, no watermark. Photoreal editorial studio photography.

SUBJECT (RIGHT panel — large head):
12-year-old Latino boy, ~145cm, slim youthful build. Warm light-brown tan skin, smooth childlike complexion, a couple of tiny natural beauty marks on the left cheek. Round-oval face, soft jaw, small rounded chin, full youthful cheeks. Dark brown almond eyes, calm neutral gaze, thick dark eyebrows with a small natural gap. Straight small nose, full lips, neutral resting expression. Clean face, no facial hair. Hair: thick dense black tight curls/coils, medium volume on top, messy natural crown, curls falling slightly over the forehead, shorter at the temples. Small silver hoop in left ear, thin delicate silver chain at the collar.
LEFT panel — OUTFIT ONLY, ghost-mannequin (invisible body, garments floating/styled as worn, no person, no head):
Modern young-adult streetwear sized for a ~20-year-old, ~180cm frame. Oversized heavyweight cotton hoodie (400gsm) as the hero piece — electric cobalt, boxy cut, slightly cropped hem, hood up-collar structure visible, drawstrings uneven. Centered chest print: "HIGGS" wordmark in acid chartreuse #d1ef17, bold sans, screen-print sitting in the weave (not glossy). Worn over a fitted metallic silver-grey baselayer poking out at cuffs and hem. Baggy low-slung cargo jeans, faded indigo, oversized pockets, contrast stitching. Chunky white-and-chartreuse dad sneakers, thick treaded gum-tinted soles, broken-in. Accessories minimal: matte-black crossbody sling with reflective trim, over-ear headphones styled around the collar, chrome ball-chain + thin chartreuse cord choker, two stacked chrome rings, carabiner + keys clipped to a cargo loop. Overall palette: saturated and clean — cobalt-led with crisp chartreuse pops, chrome accents, no muddy tones.

SCENE CONTEXT A character reference for the mother of the young man in reference 1. She must read instantly as his mother — same heritage and facial DNA, older generation — dressed in comfortable home clothes for cooking in a kitchen (wardrobe and mood per references 2, 3, 4). Three shots: a tight face portrait, a full-length front view, and a full-length back view.
ACTIVE REFERENCES Ref 1 = son's face (identity/resemblance source). Refs 2, 3, 4 = homewear and cooking-kitchen wardrobe/mood source.
CHARACTER ANCHORS (identity lock — family resemblance to the son) Woman, around 50–55. Warm olive-tan skin with the same undertone as the son, mixed Latino–Southeast-Asian heritage. Dark hair with natural curl and a few soft grey strands, mid-length, loosely pulled back with curls framing the face. Inherited facial structure straight from the son: warm dark-brown almond-shaped eyes with the same spacing and slight downturn, the same broad nose with a rounded tip, full lips, soft rounded cheeks, strong defined dark brows, the same calm steady gaze. The resemblance must be unmistakable — clearly mother and son. A neat, fine, well-groomed thin mustache along the upper lip — light, sparse, tidy and intentional, NOT thick, NOT bushy or voluminous. Small silver hoop earring and a tiny stud, like the son. Warm composed expression, neutral lips. Natural lived-in skin texture, fine pores, soft sheen, minimal makeup. 100% consistent across all three shots.
WARDROBE (homewear for cooking, per refs 2–4) Soft, relaxed domestic clothing in warm natural tones: a light linen or cotton camp-collar shirt or a white long-sleeve tee with sleeves rolled to the forearm, layered under a mid-length cotton/linen kitchen apron in beige, clay, or muted olive, tied at the waist with soft strings. Relaxed comfortable trousers below in a warm neutral tone. Soft, lived-in, gently creased fabrics. Consistent outfit across the full-length front and back shots.
SHOT 1 — FACE PORTRAIT (close-up) Framing: tight close-up, head and shoulders, face fully readable and centered. Optics: 29° diagonal field of view, short telephoto portrait lens character, camera 4 m back, flattering stable proportions, subject razor-sharp, background a soft clean light grey. Camera: eye-level, locked static.
SHOT 2 — FULL-LENGTH FRONT Framing: full figure head to feet, standing relaxed in a warm bright home kitchen, facing camera, hands natural (one resting near a cutting board or holding a wooden spoon to signal cooking). Optics: 47° standard normal lens character, camera 4–5 m back, zero distortion, straight rectilinear edges, deep focus so the full outfit reads head to hem; kitchen softly present behind. Camera: eye-level, locked static, full body centered with even margins.
SHOT 3 — FULL-LENGTH BACK Framing: full figure from directly behind, same standing pose in the same kitchen, showing the back of the shirt, apron ties, hair, and trousers. Optics: same 47° standard normal lens, same distance and height as Shot 2 for matched scale. Camera: eye-level, locked static, dead-on rear view.
LIGHTING Soft natural daylight kitchen light for the full-length shots — gentle window light, warm and airy, low contrast, soft shadows (per refs 2–4). For the portrait, soft even key from the front-upper with gentle wraparound fill so the face and the fine mustache read clearly. Natural warm skin rendering, no harsh speculars.
PHYSICS & MATERIAL Soft linen and cotton with natural folds and light creases, apron fabric draping with real weight, hair holding natural curl with slight movement, jewelry sitting with weight. Grounded, warm, photoreal domestic texture.
POSITIVE LOCKS The woman is clearly the mother of the young man in ref 1 — shared olive-tan skin, dark curly hair, brown almond eyes, broad rounded nose, and family likeness make the relationship obvious. Mustache stays fine, neat and well-groomed, never thick or bushy. Same face, hair and wardrobe consistent across all three images (outfit matched in the two full-length shots). Single subject, no extra people, no text overlays, no watermark. Photoreal editorial-meets-domestic photography, warm home-kitchen mood.

SCENE CONTEXT A massive wartime sea evacuation, captured in a single unbroken handheld take. A hundred thousand displaced civilians flood a wide stone-and-timber pier toward a single grey troopship, all running with one purpose — to reach the narrow gangway and get inside the hull. A young mother clutches a swaddled infant to her chest and runs inside the crushing crowd. The pier is so overpacked that runners trip and fall over one another, the wounded limp and stumble, and the crowd at the unrailed edge is forced off into the cold sea — not by choice, but because the mass pushing from behind drives the whole flow forward and shoves them over the edge. The mother fights up the gangway to the hull door, but there is no room left inside and she cannot push through. Weeping and screaming, she passes her baby through the bodies into the ship just as the door seals — the child gets in, the mother is shut out.
LOCATION MAP Sea coast under low smoke-grey sky. A large steel troopship moored broadside across the right and center of frame, hull spanning BG from x 45% to x 100%, deck rail running across the upper third. A wide pier extends from FG lower-center into deep-MG. At the seaward edge of the pier, center-frame at x 55%, y 48%, a single narrow boarding gangway rises from the pier edge to the hull door — barely wide enough for people to climb one at a time, far too small for the mass trying to reach it. Pier surface is wet stone and splintered planking, no railings on the open seaward edges (screen-left edge x 22%–38%, and the front edge around the gangway). Behind the pier on the landward side: a skyline of coastal buildings actively burning from air raids — collapsing rooftops, walls sheeting flame, towering fire and black smoke columns rolling into the sky. Drifting haze, ember sparks, and ash across all depth planes. Lighting comes from a flat bright overcast sky behind the ship — backlight from BG — with warm fire glow bleeding in from the burning city.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING The first visible frame is already full of running people from edge to edge — no empty establishing frame, no delayed reveal, no visible gaps between bodies anywhere in frame. The young mother is FG center-lower, x 50%, y 70%, three-quarter back to camera, facing into depth toward the ship, swaddled infant held tight against her left shoulder, her right arm shielding the baby's head. A hundred thousand bodies pack every plane shoulder-to-shoulder: huge close FG bodies (x 0%–100%, y 55%–100%), MG crowd compressing toward the narrow gangway, BG crowd as a continuous human river stretching to the horizon. The narrow gangway at the pier's seaward edge, center-frame x 55%, y 48%, is the single convergence point every body drives toward. The open unrailed pier edges run screen-left and across the front of the gangway, where the overflow is forced toward the drop. Geography reads instantly: dense crowd in front, ship ahead, narrow gangway at center, deadly unrailed water-edges left and front.
FORMAT MODE ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE, total 15s, no cuts of any kind. The camera never cuts, never fades, never dissolves — it stays unbroken from first frame to last, riding with the mother through the entire action. Real-time motion, no slow motion.
OPTICS LENS LOCK = 84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character, camera 1 to 1.5 meters from the mother throughout. Foreground bodies loom large and close, the crowd, burning skyline, ship, and gangway all stay visible to the frame edges, straight lines stay rectilinear, no fisheye curve. Immersive body-near-camera scale held for the entire unbroken take. No focal drift, no lens change.
CAMERA One continuous handheld operator shot with real physicality: shoulder-mounted mass, breath pulse, micro-settling, weight shifts, constant human re-framing as the operator is shoved and jostled inside the crowd. No digital jitter, no gimbal glide, no drone float, no cut. The camera rides close behind the mother and slightly to her right for the whole shot — pushing forward through the crush with her, swept and bumped by passing bodies, tilting up briefly as aircraft scream overhead, dropping and weaving past the unrailed edge as people are forced over, then climbing the gangway tight on her back, and finally settling at eye level on her face at the hull door as the baby is passed inside and the door seals. The camera's path is one unbroken move that follows her journey end to end.
ACTION TIMING (single continuous take) 0.0s — The first frame is already a packed running mass with no gaps. The mother runs forward inside the surge, infant clamped to her chest, head ducked. The camera moves with her from behind. 0.0s–4.0s — She glances back once over her right shoulder with wide panicked eyes. All around, the crowd runs the same direction toward the gangway, each at a different speed and tempo — faster runners weave and shove past slower ones. Some trip and fall; others stumble over the fallen. A wounded man limps and is swept along. ~3.0s — Warplanes scream low over the crowd's heads with a deafening roar; heads snap upward in terror, then duck and keep running in panic. Fire and smoke roll across the sky from the burning city behind. 4.0s–9.0s — The camera pushes with her into the peak of the crush at the unrailed seaward edge by the narrow gangway. People right at the edge try to turn and push back inland to avoid falling, straining backward — but the immense crowd pressing from behind drives the whole flow forward and forces them over. At ~5.5s a man is shoved off; falling, he twists and claws at the lip of the pier, fingers scraping wet stone, fighting to hold on before he slips into the sea. At ~6.5s a chain of people is pushed over together as the mass surges blindly; some grab the edge and each other, legs kicking, before dropping into the cold water. At the center the single narrow gangway is mobbed — far more people than it can hold; some claw up it one at a time, some lose their grip and tumble off, others are shoved clean off the pier by those desperate to push forward. The mother is squeezed and slammed shoulder-to-shoulder, nearly knocked down at ~8.0s, staying upright only by bracing against the bodies around her, the infant pressed and protected. 9.0s–12.0s — She forces her way to the top of the narrow gangway and reaches the hull door, the camera climbing tight behind her. The doorway is jammed solid with bodies pressing inside — no room, she cannot push through, blocked at the threshold by the wall of people. ~12.0s — Realizing she will not make it, her face breaks: tears streaming, mouth open in a scream, she lifts the swaddled infant high and pushes the baby forward into the crowd, hands inside passing the child along over heads into the dark of the hull. ~13.5s — The baby is pulled safely inside. The heavy steel hull door begins to swing shut. ~14.0s — The door seals with a deep metallic boom directly in front of the mother's face, shutting her out on the gangway as the crowd churns and the city burns behind. 15.0s — Final frame: the mother's anguished face against the closed steel, her child safe inside.
PHYSICS Every runner has real ground contact, heel strike, weight transfer, torso lean, varied stride length, speed, and fatigue — each body moving at its own tempo. Bodies have mass: collisions transfer force, shoves cause real stagger and recovery, trips send people sprawling and others tumbling over them. The edge falls are driven by visible crowd pressure from behind overpowering those trying to retreat; falling people fight to hold on, clawing and gripping the pier lip, fingers dragging on wet stone, grabbing at others before gravity takes them. They accelerate under gravity and hit the water with real splash, displacement, and parabolic spray; water churns and laps against the pilings. The narrow gangway flexes and rings under climbing weight; people slip off its edges with real loss of balance. The infant's swaddle and the mother's clothing have cloth inertia — fabric lags and snaps; the baby's weight transfers realistically as she lifts and passes it. Aircraft overhead produce a pressure wash that stirs dust and clothing. Hair, dust, embers, and ash drift and settle by wind direction. The steel hull door carries heavy momentum and hinge resistance, slamming with follow-through. Fire and smoke columns rise and shear with wind across correct depth planes. No floating bodies, no weightless props, correct contact shadows everywhere.
LIGHTING Natural light only. Key light is the flat bright overcast sky behind the ship — backlight, contre-jour. Camera stays on the shadow side of the crowd; faces fall into soft shadow, revealed by sky bounce, wet skin speculars, and eye catch-lights rather than any frontal fill. Warm, flickering fire glow from the burning city rakes across the crowd and the hull from the landward side, mixing with the cold sky light. Atmospheric haze, smoke, and embers diffuse the light through every plane, raising the background into a luminous grey-and-orange wash and silhouetting the human mass. In the final beat, the mother's tear-streaked face catches a sliver of rim light against the dark steel door. Exposed for the bright sky, not for the faces. No flat front light, no studio key, no beauty fill.
PHYSICAL REALISM OF PEOPLE Pore-level skin realism on the mother and every visible extra: asymmetric faces, real wrinkles, sweat, soot smears, capillary flush, vellus hair, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise. Clothing is filthy, dust-caked, torn, frayed, and war-worn on everyone; some carry visible wounds, blood, and bandages, and limp as they run. Eyes carry genuine panic and fear; micro-pauses before reactions; faces strained with exhaustion and terror. Crowd individuals are distinct, never duplicated or cloned, packed shoulder-to-shoulder with no empty gaps, extending into a hundred-thousand-strong human river to the horizon.
AUDIO Environmental SFX only — a hundred thousand running feet on stone, panicked shouts and cries, the infant wailing, the mother's scream as she passes the baby, the deafening roar of low-flying warplanes overhead, bodies hitting water, the roar and crack of the burning city, distant artillery and collapsing structures, the final heavy metallic door boom. No music, no narration, no subtitles.
POSITIVE LOCKS 4K Seedance 2.0, maximum detail on every element — skin, fabric, stone, water, fire, smoke, and crowd depth all rendered at highest fidelity. 8K IMAX photorealistic war film, not 3D render, not game engine, not cutscene aesthetic. Cinematography in the tradition of Christopher Nolan, Steven Spielberg, and Stanley Kubrick — grounded, heavy, dread-soaked realism. Kodak Vision3 500T texture, real film grain, naturalistic backlit silhouette, low-key grounded physical cinema. Rule-of-thirds and golden-ratio composition. One unbroken continuous handheld take with no cuts. The narrow gangway convergence point stays center-frame at the pier's seaward edge throughout; the deadly open water-edges stay screen-left and front; the mother and infant identity, wardrobe, dirt, and the swaddle remain identical from first frame to last with no drift. The frame is always solid with people, no empty gaps between bodies. Every person is running with purpose toward the ship at their own tempo from frame one. 24fps smooth real-time motion; no jitter.

depth, dramatic radial light-streamers and energy lines, heavy bloom, chromatic
aberration, anamorphic flares, gritty grain and texture, blood-spatter realism.
Native 4K ultra-high detail: every spark, energy line, blood droplet, ember and
debris shard rendered sharp and individually readable; rich painterly texture.
FACE & ACTING QUALITY: premium movie-grade character animation — highly detailed
faces with skin texture, sweat, blood smears, flushed strain, fine hair strands
and sharp catch-lights in the glowing eyes; vivid, raw, emotional expressions —
gritted bloodied teeth, blazing wide eyes, savage fury and desperate effort;
expressive frame-by-frame facial acting.
LIGHTING: dark battlefield ambient split into a cold blue half and a hot crimson
half; intense blue energy glow on the hero and red energy glow on the rival as the
two violent accents; a blinding white core flash at the point of impact; hard rim
separating both fighters from the dark debris field; thousands of glowing streaks,
particles and embers refracting light.
COLOR: deep black-and-blue on the left, blood-crimson on the right, a white impact
core at center; the two fighters the saturated subjects; high contrast, gritty,
no flat color.
CAMERA: anamorphic cine optics, real motion blur, register shifts, strong dynamic
foreshortening — explosive crash on the entrance and collision, sweeping orbit on
the clash, extreme slow macro on the sparks and blood particles, a fast whip-spin
into the finishing super strike; radial speed-streamers and energy lines ripping
from the impact center.
MATERIAL: glowing semi-translucent energy streamers in blue and crimson, energy-
wrapped fists, tattered fabric and torn cloaks, dark articulated outfits, blood
droplets and smears, shattered rocky ground, suspended jagged rubble, crystalline
energy fragments, fine dust and countless embers.
PARTICLE DETAIL: dense, finely-detailed particle work — radial energy streaks,
sparks, blood droplets, crystalline shards, rock grit, dust and embers fill the
air in layered depth; sparks and small particles drift and streak in slow motion,
each catching light; the air shimmers and distorts around the energies.
PHYSICS: true force and momentum — fists and energy meet with a radial shockwave
that quakes and cracks the ground outward, blasting a ground-shaking dust-and-
debris ring; rubble, blood and energy shards blast away in slow arcs and fall
under gravity; cloaks and hair whip in the blast wind; energy streamers snap and
trail with motion; lightning and energy fork with real branching.
COMPOSITION: spectacular dynamic-angle wide on the two-fighter clash split blue-
vs-red, orbit around the impact, extreme macro on the core and flying particles, a
spinning low-angle on the hero's finishing super strike, then a wide on the rival
disintegrating; depth from foreground rubble and sparks to the fighters to the
dark sky; explosive kinetic scale.
CHARACTER DESIGN (original, not based on any franchise):
- BLUE HERO: a young male fighter with spiky dark hair with crimson-red tips,
glowing blue eyes, a torn dark outfit and trailing cape, blood-smeared muscled
arms; his right fist and forearm are wrapped in surging blue energy with a
water/lightning streamer trailing behind. Fierce, savage, heroic.
- RED RIVAL: a male fighter with dark wind-blown hair, a torn crimson cloak,
wreathed in violent red energy streamers; battered, snarling, ferocious.
CONTINUITY: same blue hero, same red rival, same energies, same shattered
battlefield and dark sky across all cuts.
AUDIO: diegetic only — howling wind and low rumble, two roaring battle shouts, a
ground-quaking detonation on the clash, snapping energy streamers, a rising charge
hum on the super strike, a colossal final impact, a soft dissolving shimmer as the
rival turns to dust, ringing silence and a subsonic boom.
SCENE CONTEXT
On a shattered battlefield, a blue-energy hero and a crimson-energy rival charge
in and collide head-on in an earth-shaking detonation of blue and red power; after
a brutal exchange the hero unleashes a spinning super strike that disintegrates
the rival into atoms and particles, dissolving him into drifting dust.
LOCATION MAP
Foreground: shattered rocky ground, suspended rubble, dust and energy shards.
Midground: the two fighters, blue hero screen-left, red rival screen-right.
Background: dark battlefield, the frame split into a cold-blue left half and a
crimson right half. The white impact core sits dead center between them.
FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Matches the reference: low dynamic foreshortened angle, the blue hero lunging from
screen-left with his energy-wrapped fist thrust toward center, blood-smeared and
screaming, glowing blue eyes; the red rival recoiling at screen-right wreathed in
crimson energy, struck and snarling; fist and energies meet at center in a
blinding white core bursting radial blue-and-red streamers across the whole frame;
shattered ground below, debris and blood droplets suspended, blue/red split light.
FORMAT MODE
Controlled multi-shot sequence, ~15 seconds total, with HARD CUTS at 3.0s, 6.0s,
9.0s and 12.0s. Mixed real-time and slow motion. The camera does not cut on its own.
OPTICS
SEGMENT 1 (0.0–3.0s) — WS 63° dynamic wide entrance and clash. SEGMENT 2
(3.0–6.0s) — MS 47° orbit on the impact. SEGMENT 3 (6.0–9.0s) — ECU 18° extreme
macro on the core, sparks and blood particles. SEGMENT 4 (9.0–12.0s) — WS 63°
low-angle on the hero's spinning charge. SEGMENT 5 (12.0–15.0s) — WS 63° on the
finishing super strike and the rival's disintegration. No drift mid-segment.
CAMERA
A spectacular crash-wide on the entrance and collision, a fast sweeping orbit
around the impact, an extreme slow macro pushing into the core and particles, a
whip-spin following the hero's rotation, then a wide hold on the rival dissolving
to dust.
ACTION
0.0s–3.0s (real time, explosive): the blue hero and red rival burst into frame from
opposite sides — cloaks snapping, blue and crimson energy streamers flaring — and
collide head-on, energy-fist against energy, detonating a blinding white core that
quakes and cracks the ground, blasting a ground-shaking dust-and-debris ring and
radial streamers outward, both screaming, faces vivid and bloodied.
3.0s HARD CUT.
3.0s–6.0s (slow motion): orbit around the locked clash; blue energy spirals up the
hero's arm, crimson energy lashes around the rival, both straining, sweat, blood
and strain on their detailed faces, fine particles and droplets drifting around them.
6.0s HARD CUT.
6.0s–9.0s (extreme slow motion): macro on the white-hot impact core; in dense
detail a shockwave-driven wind of energy, blood droplets and sparks burst outward
and spiral toward the lens, each particle sharp and glowing, the air vibrating and
rippling.
9.0s HARD CUT.
9.0s–12.0s (real time into slow motion): the hero breaks the lock, eyes blazing,
and gathers all his blue energy around his body; he drops low and begins a powerful
spinning rotation — a whirling spin-strike — the blue energy spiraling into a
coiling vortex around his fist, dragging in dust, blood-mist and sparks, the rival's
battered eyes going wide.
12.0s HARD CUT.
12.0s–15.0s (slow motion into real time): the hero completes the spin and unleashes
the finishing super strike — a massive spiraling blue energy blow that slams the
rival dead-on with a blinding flash. In hyper-detailed slow motion the rival is torn
apart atom by atom: his silhouette freezes for a beat, then fractures into countless
glowing particles and crystalline motes that scatter and drift, dissolving into the
air and leaving only a slowly settling cloud of dust on the wind. The hero lands from
the spin, energy fading. Hold on the empty drifting dust. Hard cut to black.
PHYSICS
The entrance collision quakes and cracks the ground with a real shockwave and dust
ring; rubble, blood and energy shards blast away in slow arcs and fall under gravity;
cloaks and hair whip in the blast wind; the spinning charge builds rotational
momentum, the vortex dragging in dust and mist; the final super strike disperses the
rival into particles that drift and settle as dust with true air physics.
LIGHTING
Battlefield split cold-blue left / hot-crimson right; intense blue and red energy
glow rim-lighting both fighters; a blinding white core flash at impact; a bright
blue surge on the super strike; the rival's dissolving particles glow softly as they
scatter. Embers and motes refracting. No flat light, no clean color.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Same blue hero (spiky red-tipped dark hair, blue eyes, blue energy fist) and same
red rival (dark hair, crimson cloak, red energy) in every cut, both original designs.
Spectacular entrance and earth-shaking head-on collision split blue-vs-red; locked
energies with dense particle and blood detail and slow-mo sparks; the hero wins with
a spinning super strike; the rival freezes, then disintegrates into atoms and
particles and dissolves into dust. Native 4K, movie-grade painterly art, highly
detailed emotional bloodied faces; explosive cinematic anime action throughout.

SCENE CONTEXT A single modern 4K Smart TV remote control prop, stripped down to a minimal button set, presented as a clean three-view product reference: front face, true side profile, and back shell. No hands, no environment, object only on a flat neutral medium-grey seamless background.
OBJECT Slim minimalist Smart TV remote, contemporary 2020s design language, matte-black soft-touch polymer body, rounded corners, thin tapered thickness. Reduced, primitive button layout — no streaming-app shortcut buttons (no Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Disney), no mic button, no back/home buttons.
Front face layout, top to bottom:
A single round power button at the very top-right.
Directly below the power area, a large "higgs 4K" wordmark in bright lime-chartreuse green, hex #D2F84E, prominently sized as the hero logo across the upper face.
Below the logo, a large central circular navigation ring with a glossy black round OK/select key in the middle and a thin chrome ring; four directional arrows (up, down, left, right) printed on the ring at top, bottom, left and right positions.
Below the ring, two simple control pairs side by side: a volume rocker on the left (a "+" key above a "−" key, small "VOL" label) and a channel rocker on the right (an up-chevron above a down-chevron, small "CH" label).
Clean, uncluttered, lots of empty matte-black space, premium minimalist aesthetic. Back shell: smooth tapered surface with a subtle recessed battery-compartment cover and a small "higgs 4K" logo in lime-chartreuse #D2F84E near the bottom.
LAYOUT Three identical remotes arranged left to right on the same horizontal baseline, evenly spaced, equal scale. Left = front view, face toward camera, fully readable. Center = strict side profile, edge-on in plane, showing thickness and slightly raised buttons in silhouette. Right = back view, rear shell toward camera. Object centered vertically, generous equal margins, no overlap, no cropping.
OPTICS 47° diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 3 to 4 meters back, zero distortion, straight rectilinear edges, natural proportions, deep depth of field so all three views stay razor-sharp front to back.
CAMERA Eye-level, locked static, dead-on orthographic framing for each view. No perspective tilt, no foreshortening.
LIGHTING Even soft studio softbox key from the front-upper, broad and shadowless, subtle gradient falloff on the grey background. Soft contact shadow directly beneath each remote to anchor it. No harsh reflections, no blown speculars, matte surfaces read as matte, the lime logo stays saturated and clean.
MATERIAL Soft-touch polymer absorbs light, rubber buttons show faint sheen, the lime-chartreuse "higgs 4K" logo reads as crisp colored print, chrome navigation ring shows a thin clean highlight. Pristine, dust-free, no fingerprints.
POSITIVE LOCKS Minimal primitive 4K Smart TV remote only — buttons limited to: power, central directional ring with OK and four arrows, volume rocker, channel rocker. No app shortcut buttons, no mic, no back/home keys. No hands, no props, no text overlays except the "higgs 4K" logo and the small VOL/CH labels and arrow glyphs. The "higgs 4K" logo color stays exactly lime-chartreuse hex #D2F84E on both front and back. Background stays flat neutral medium grey. All three views share identical body, color, scale, and lighting. Logo spelling stays exactly "higgs 4K".

 — the location: a vast range of steep snow-covered peaks, rocky ridgelines and ledges, layered summits fading into cold blue atmospheric haze, cold daylight. 100% matches the reference.

Character design sheet, single subject shown twice on one image, split into two panels
on a seamless neutral grey studio background.

LEFT PANEL — full body, head-to-toe, heroic frontal stance:
A tall humanoid warrior carved from richly colored stone — warm sandstone and ochre rock
streaked with rusty iron-red veins, bands of pale cream mineral and patches of turquoise
copper patina. The body has a heavy, muscular anatomy built from solid rough-hewn stone
blocks — chest, shoulders and thighs formed of chiseled plates with cracked seams between
them. The surface is matte and coarse, covered in chisel marks, vivid green moss and lichen
in the crevices, fine erosion pitting, and embedded amber and quartz crystals catching the
light. Hands are massive, blunt, carved like boulders with chipped knuckles. In one hand he
grips a long greatsword forged from a single slab of dark stone with reddish mineral veins,
the edge crudely sharpened, the grip wrapped in old weathered rope and leather. Rubble,
dust and small loose stones gather at his feet on the grey floor.

RIGHT PANEL — close-up portrait of the same face, three-quarter angle:
A stern, heavy face hewn from warm ochre and sandstone rock, blocky brow, broad flat
cheekbones and a hard square jaw, the surface rough and fractured with deep cracks streaked
with rust-red and cream mineral veins. Instead of hair, jagged slabs and broken rock shards
jut upward from the skull like a crown of cracked boulders, vivid green moss and lichen
clinging in the crevices, small turquoise patina spots and amber crystals scattered across
the stone. Fine dust and grit cling to the surface.

neutral light with smooth shadows, low contrast, rich natural stone colors, subtle specular

hulking anatomy — broad shoulders, thick arms, a wide muscular torso — the skin mottled

yellowed tusks jut from the lower jaw, bony ridges and warty knobs run along the shoulders

leather and swamp vine. Murky water, mud, reeds and lily pads scatter at his feet on the
grey floor.

heavy brow, broad nostrils and a massive jaw with protruding yellowed tusks. Wet slimy
skin streaked with mud and clinging algae, small leeches and bog moss in the deep skin
folds. Small sunken eyes glowing a dull murky amber-green. Instead of hair, tangled wet
reeds, swamp weeds and bony spines drape back over the skull. Drips of water and slime on
the surface.

Driving on snow: <<<78679d77-abd4-4036-9516-c795b77b5bf8>>> rides on purpose-built winter rubber — massive deep-lug snow tires with aggressive blocky tread, sipes and metal studs biting into the packed snow, plus studded rear snow-tracks for flotation. The heavy chassis sits low and planted, suspension compressing over ridges and lurching through swerves, throwing continuous white snow-spray and powder rooster-tails. Exhaust stacks vent hot steam shearing backward (screen-left). Engine at full strain, genuinely heavy mass and momentum.
Obstacles: the plow blade meets each barricade with real impact — packed snow shatters and sprays, ice slabs crack and tumble with weight, the truck's mass barely deflects as it punches through; swerves load the suspension and shift the chassis with believable inertia and grip-loss.

It leaves the ground carrying its full mass and load — heavy engine block, armor plating, fuel weight pulling the center of gravity low and forward — so it rotates with believable, slightly sluggish angular momentum, not a light flip. During the airborne rotations every wheel and track stays firmly mounted in its correct factory position — wheels keep spinning under their own inertia but never detach, dislodge, shift along the axle, droop, or float out of place; front tires stay on the front axle, rear tracks stay at the rear, all geometry intact. Negative: cartoon, painterly, blurry, low detail, text artifacts, watermark, distorted anatomy.

SCENE CONTEXT
A young rider flies on a small, brightly colored coral-reef flying creature through a colossal Avatar-style jungle of mile-high fantastical trees. No words — she steers with her body and pure joy, laughing and whooping as the creature pulls off daring tricks: diving through a cloud of giant butterflies, weaving between branches and lianas, skimming inches over a thundering waterfall, threading a razor-narrow gap, then climbing straight up the trunks and bursting above the canopy into a vast reveal of the whole world. One continuous soaring flight. Text-to-video, everything described inline, no reference images.
FORMAT MODE
Single continuous take (or up to 2 clean HARD CUTS on motion if staging requires). Real-time motion. 15 seconds, 16:9 anamorphic widescreen. No subtitles, no music, no dialogue.
THE CREATURE (full description, identical every frame)
A small, friendly flying creature the size of a large dolphin — soft rounded body, a gentle beaky/snouted face with a short downturned snout, big soulful golden eyes with round dark pupils, no teeth bared, never aggressive. Its skin is iridescent: a base of glowing teal-to-turquoise veined all over with branching coral-red, magenta and warm gold lines, like living reef coral grown into a body. A scatter of small pale barnacle-shells clusters on its back and shoulders. Broad membranous wings shaped like manta-ray fins, fringed with delicate coral-feather edges, translucent at the tips where the sun shines through. A long ribboned tail trails behind, ending in a wide gold-tipped fan. Endearing and clearly alive — it blinks, chirps, tilts its head and glances back at the rider. The exact same design, colors, shell placement, wing shape and fan-tail in every single frame — no morphing, no drift.
THE RIDER (full description, same person every frame)
A joyful young woman, 20–25, athletic and light, warm sun-tanned skin, long dark windswept hair streaming in the airflow. She wears simple flowing clothes in earth-and-jewel tones — a fitted sleeveless top and wrapped trousers in moss-green and deep teal with a thin coral sash, fabric rippling in the wind. Bare forearms, a few woven cord bracelets. Her face is pure delight — eyes wide with wonder, mouth open in a laughing grin, cheeks flushed from speed. She sits just behind the creature's shoulders, knees tucked, hands gripping its shoulder-ridge, body leaning, ducking and bracing into every bank, dive and roll. Real, expressive, charming, the same face and outfit throughout.
THE LOCATION (full description — maximum color and life)
A surreal, monumental rainforest of impossible scale. The trees are mile-high fantastical giants — colossal pillar-trunks wider than towers, bark in deep browns and mossy greens, climbing so high their crowns vanish into golden mist; their upper branches fuse into vaulted green cathedral arches. Thick horizontal branches and long hanging lianas cross the flight path at many depths, and one pair of trunks leans together to form a razor-narrow vertical gap. A colossal waterfall pours down one of the giant trunks into a glowing turquoise pool and mist-filled gorge, sunlight throwing rainbows across the spray. The whole jungle blazes with color: cascading flowers in magenta, violet, orange and gold, glowing bioluminescent blooms, hanging curtains of pink and blue blossom, emerald spiral ferns, turquoise moss, oversized jewel-toned leaves. SCENE CONTEXT

She talks to it like a friend, calling it by name and steering it with her voice as they weave between giant branches, hanging lianas, flocking birds and tree-dwelling monkeys — then climb straight up along the enormous trunks and burst above the canopy into a vast establishing reveal of the whole world. One continuous soaring flight. Text-to-video, everything described inline, no reference images.
FORMAT MODE
Single continuous take (or up to 2 clean HARD CUTS on motion if staging requires). Real-time motion. 15 seconds, 16:9 anamorphic widescreen. No subtitles, no music.
THE CREATURE (full description, identical every frame)
A small, friendly flying creature the size of a large dolphin — soft rounded body, a gentle beaky/snouted face with a short downturned snout, big soulful golden eyes with round dark pupils, no teeth bared, never aggressive. Its skin is iridescent: a base of glowing teal-to-turquoise veined all over with branching coral-red, magenta and warm gold lines, like living reef coral grown into a body. A scatter of small pale barnacle-shells clusters on its back and shoulders. It has broad membranous wings shaped like manta-ray fins fringed with delicate coral-feather edges, translucent at the tips where the sun shines through. A long ribboned tail trails behind, ending in a wide gold-tipped fan. It is endearing and clearly alive — it blinks, chirps, tilts its head, and glances back at the rider. The exact same design, colors, shell placement, wing shape and fan-tail in every single frame — no morphing, no drift.
THE RIDER (full description, same person every frame)
A joyful young woman, 20–25, athletic and light, warm sun-tanned skin, long dark windswept hair streaming behind her in the airflow. She wears simple flowing clothes in earth-and-jewel tones — a fitted sleeveless top and wrapped trousers in moss-green and deep teal with a thin coral sash, fabric rippling in the wind. Bare forearms, a few woven cord bracelets. Her eyes are wide with wonder and delight, cheeks flushed from speed; she grins and laughs. She sits just behind the creature's shoulders, knees tucked, hands lightly gripping its shoulder-ridge, body leaning and shifting into every bank and dive. Real, expressive, charming, the same face and outfit throughout.
THE LOCATION (full description)
A surreal, monumental rainforest of impossible scale. The trees are mile-high fantastical giants — colossal pillar-trunks wider than towers, bark in deep browns and mossy greens, climbing so high their crowns vanish into golden mist. Their upper branches fuse into vaulted canopies overhead, forming a green cathedral of arches. Thick horizontal branches and long hanging lianas cross the flight path at many depths. Glowing bioluminescent flowers and bromeliad clusters dot the trunks; spiral ferns and oversized leaves crowd every limb. The air is alive: flocks of small brilliant birds (cobalt, scarlet, gold) wheel through the shafts of light, and slender long-limbed monkeys leap and swing between the boughs, pausing to watch as the creature passes. High screen-right, warm golden sun rakes down through the canopy in thick volumetric god-rays, lighting drifting waterfall-mist and floating pollen. Everything human or animal is tiny against the trees. Deep parallax: foreground vines and leaves rush past, midground trunks and wildlife slide by, the far canopy and sky shift slowly behind.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains the creature and rider, mid-flight, gliding through a towering green archway — tiny against the scale. No empty establishing frame, no delayed reveal. The creature center frame, x 50%, y 55%, broad wings spread, banking slightly. The rider seated just behind its shoulders, leaning forward, eyes forward along the flight path. Birds scatter ahead in the midground; a monkey perches on a branch foreground-left, x 18%, y 40%, tracking them as they pass. The flight path runs forward into deep green tunnel space, then upward at the end.
OPTICS
84° diagonal field of view, classic wide-angle lens character flying alongside the creature, camera 1–1.5 m off its wing. Strong but natural perspective expansion — foreground vines and branches loom large and rush past, the giant trunks stay visible to the frame edges, straight trunk lines stay rectilinear, no fisheye curve. Immersive, body-near flight feel. For the final climb and reveal, ease wider toward a 107° wide rectilinear environmental character to sell the colossal scale of the full landscape.
CAMERA
Smooth sweeping flight camera that flies WITH the creature — banking alongside it, dropping into dives, threading between branches, then craning and tilting up to follow the vertical climb. Real motion blur on fast foreground elements, soft natural lens flares as the sun crosses the lens. Operator-grade fluid motion, not floaty drone drift. Solid, consistent jungle geometry as the camera moves — no warping, melting or repeating-clone smear.
ACTION TIMING
0.0s–5.0s — UNDER THE CANOPY: camera sweeps through a giant green archway and finds the creature and rider gliding through the vast tunnel of trees, birds bursting off the branches around them, a monkey leaping between limbs in the midground. The rider leans forward.
At 0.5s the rider speaks: "Hey, Manta — let's fly over there!" The creature chirps and tips its wings toward the new heading.
5.0s–10.0s — THE WEAVE: the creature dives and banks hard, threading between two massive crossing branches and a curtain of hanging lianas, leaves and vines whipping past in the foreground, monkeys swinging clear, a flock of bright birds peeling away.
At 6.0s the rider calls: "Now go right, Manta — right!" The creature rolls right; wind ripples its plumage and the rider's hair.
At 8.5s, mid barrel-roll through a tight gap, the rider throws her head back and shouts: "Woohoo! That's amazing!"
10.0s–15.0s — THE CLIMB AND REVEAL: the creature pitches up and powers straight upward along the colossal trunks, wings beating hard, the camera tilting up and craning back as bark, branches and birds streak downward past the lens. They burst up through the top of the canopy into open golden sky. The camera cranes back into a colossal wide establishing shot revealing the WHOLE world at once — an endless sea of mile-high trees rolling to the horizon, rivers of mist between them, waterfalls catching the sun, the tiny creature and rider a bright speck rising above it all.
At 12.5s, as they break above the canopy, the rider laughs and says: "So cool — good boy, Manta!" Hold on the wonder as the creature levels off, glances back at her and chirps.
PHYSICS
The creature flaps, glides, banks, rolls and climbs with real wing dynamics, mass and inertia — wings load and push air on each beat, the body leans into every turn, the vertical climb visibly costs effort with deeper wingbeats, the long tail trails and counter-sways. The rider's body shifts and braces with each bank and pitch, weight transferring, hair and clothes streaming with airspeed and gust direction. Branches, leaves and lianas bend and recoil as they pass. Birds and monkeys react with real evasive motion. Motion has acceleration and deceleration, never floaty.
LIGHTING
Primary light is warm golden sun high on screen-right, raking through the canopy in volumetric god-rays and catching mist and pollen. Maximum vibrancy and luminosity — deep emerald and jade greens, cobalt-to-turquoise sky, warm gold accents, pops of scarlet and coral from birds and the creature. As they break above the canopy the light opens up into bright open daylight across the whole landscape. Rich, saturated, glowing, painterly, never muddy or washed-out. Sun rim-lights the creature's wings and the rider's hair; soft environmental bounce fills the shadows.
AUDIO
SFX only: wind and steady wing-beats building to harder beats on the climb, the creature's soft friendly chirps (especially answering the rider), the rider's delighted breath and laughter, distant birdsong and monkey calls, leaves rushing past, faint waterfalls below. Only the four scripted English lines are spoken, by the rider; her lips move only for those lines, still otherwise. The creature does not speak — it only chirps. No narration, no offscreen voices, no music.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Colossal surreal scale held throughout — the creature and rider are a tiny bright speck against mile-high trees, and the final wide reveals the entire landscape at once. The creature keeps the exact same design every frame — same teal-and-coral colors, barnacle-shells, manta wings, gold fan-tail, golden eyes — no morphing, no drift; the rider is the same person with the same face and outfit throughout. Coherent, solid jungle and tree architecture with real perspective; vibrant glowing color all the way through; charming, physically believable flight.

One continuous soaring flight. Text-to-video, everything described inline, no reference images.
FORMAT MODE
Single continuous take (or up to 2 clean HARD CUTS on motion if staging requires). Real-time motion. 15 seconds, 16:9 anamorphic widescreen. No subtitles, no music, no dialogue.
THE CREATURE (full description, identical every frame)
A small, friendly flying creature the size of a large dolphin — soft rounded body, a gentle beaky/snouted face with a short downturned snout, big soulful golden eyes with round dark pupils, no teeth bared, never aggressive. Its skin is iridescent: a base of glowing teal-to-turquoise veined all over with branching coral-red, magenta and warm gold lines, like living reef coral grown into a body. A scatter of small pale barnacle-shells clusters on its back and shoulders. Broad membranous wings shaped like manta-ray fins, fringed with delicate coral-feather edges, translucent at the tips where the sun shines through. A long ribboned tail trails behind, ending in a wide gold-tipped fan. Endearing and clearly alive — it blinks, chirps, tilts its head and glances back at the rider. The exact same design, colors, shell placement, wing shape and fan-tail in every single frame — no morphing, no drift.
THE RIDER (full description, same person every frame)
A joyful young woman, 20–25, athletic and light, warm sun-tanned skin, long dark windswept hair streaming in the airflow. She wears simple flowing clothes in earth-and-jewel tones — a fitted sleeveless top and wrapped trousers in moss-green and deep teal with a thin coral sash, fabric rippling in the wind. Bare forearms, a few woven cord bracelets. Her face is pure delight — eyes wide with wonder, mouth open in a laughing grin, cheeks flushed from speed. She sits just behind the creature's shoulders, knees tucked, hands gripping its shoulder-ridge, body leaning, ducking and bracing into every bank, dive and roll. Real, expressive, charming, the same face and outfit throughout.
THE LOCATION (full description — maximum color and life)
A surreal, monumental rainforest of impossible scale. The trees are mile-high fantastical giants — colossal pillar-trunks wider than towers, bark in deep browns and mossy greens, climbing so high their crowns vanish into golden mist; their upper branches fuse into vaulted green cathedral arches. Thick horizontal branches and long hanging lianas cross the flight path at many depths, and one pair of trunks leans together to form a razor-narrow vertical gap. The whole jungle blazes with color: cascading flowers in magenta, violet, orange and gold, glowing bioluminescent blooms, hanging curtains of pink and blue blossom, emerald spiral ferns, turquoise moss, oversized jewel-toned leaves. It teems with diverse wildlife — dense flocks of brilliant birds (scarlet macaw-like fliers, cobalt songbirds, gold-and-green parrots, long iridescent hummingbirds, big slow butterflies the size of kites), long-limbed monkeys swinging between boughs, tree-frogs and lizards in neon greens and blues on the trunks, a pair of huge gentle deer-like grazers far below, glowing insects drifting in the light. High screen-right, warm golden sun rakes down through the canopy in thick volumetric god-rays, catching waterfall-mist and floating pollen. Everything alive is tiny against the trees. Deep parallax: foreground vines, flowers and leaves rush past, midground trunks and wildlife slide by, the far canopy and sky shift slowly behind.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains the creature and rider, mid-flight, gliding through a towering flower-draped archway — tiny against the scale. No empty establishing frame, no delayed reveal. The creature center frame, x 50%, y 55%, broad wings spread, banking. The rider seated just behind its shoulders, leaning forward, laughing, eyes forward along the path. Birds scatter ahead; butterflies drift through the foreground; a monkey perches branch-left, x 18%, y 40%, tracking them. The flight path runs forward into deep green tunnel space, through the narrow gap, then upward at the end.
OPTICS
107° diagonal field of view, wide rectilinear lens character, camera held very close — 0.5–0.8 m off the creature's wing and shoulder, almost riding with them. Immediate foreground (wingtip, the rider's streaming hair, rushing vines and flowers) looms large; the surrounding jungle spreads wide to all frame edges; straight trunk lines stay straight, subtle chromatic aberration near the edges, no fisheye bubble, no circular vignette. Immersive, body-near, GoPro-on-the-creature intimacy with huge environmental width. Through the narrow gap the closeness makes the walls feel like they're brushing the lens.
CAMERA
Smooth, fast flight camera locked close to the creature — banking hard alongside it, dropping into dives, snapping through the narrow gap, then craning and tilting up to follow the vertical climb. Strong real motion blur on fast foreground elements as walls and branches whip past; soft natural lens flares as the sun crosses the lens. Operator-grade fluid motion with a touch of energetic weight, not floaty drone drift. Solid, consistent jungle geometry throughout — no warping, melting or repeating-clone smear.
ACTION TIMING
0.0s–4.0s — INTO THE COLOR: camera rides tight alongside as the creature glides through a flower-draped archway and dives into the vast jungle tunnel; clouds of birds and giant butterflies burst off the branches around them, monkeys leaping in the midground, neon frogs on the trunks. The rider laughs, hair streaming.
4.0s–7.0s — THE WEAVE: the creature banks and rolls hard, threading between two massive crossing branches and a curtain of hanging lianas, leaves and flowers whipping past the lens, parrots and hummingbirds scattering. The rider ducks low and lets out a delighted whoop.
7.0s–10.0s — THE NARROW GAP: the creature folds its wings and shoots through a razor-narrow vertical gap between two leaning trunks — bark walls blurring past inches from the lens — then snaps its wings open on the far side in a corkscrew roll past a swooping flock. The rider throws her head back, laughing and cheering with pure exhilaration.
10.0s–15.0s — THE CLIMB AND REVEAL: the creature pitches up and powers straight upward along the colossal trunks, wings beating hard, bark, branches, flowers and birds streaking downward past the lens as the camera tilts up and cranes back. They burst up through the top of the canopy into open golden sky. The camera pulls back into a colossal wide establishing shot revealing the WHOLE world at once — an endless sea of mile-high trees rolling to the horizon, rivers of mist between them, waterfalls catching the sun, distant flocks like drifting confetti, the tiny creature and rider a bright speck rising above it all. The rider laughs breathlessly in wonder as the creature levels off, glances back at her and chirps. Hold on the awe.
PHYSICS
The creature flaps, glides, banks, rolls, folds and climbs with real wing dynamics, mass and inertia — wings load and push air on each beat, fold tight for the gap and snap open with a visible jolt, the body leans into every turn, the vertical climb visibly costs effort, the long tail trails and counter-sways. The rider's body shifts, ducks and braces with every move, weight transferring; her hair and clothes stream and snap with airspeed and gust direction. Branches, lianas, flowers and leaves bend and recoil as they pass. Birds, butterflies, monkeys and ground animals react with real evasive motion. Motion has acceleration and deceleration, never floaty.
LIGHTING
Primary light is warm golden sun high on screen-right, raking through the canopy in volumetric god-rays and catching mist, pollen and insect wings. Maximum vibrancy and luminosity — deep emerald and jade greens, cobalt-to-turquoise sky, warm gold accents, blazing pops of scarlet, magenta, violet and coral from flowers, birds and the creature. In the narrow gap the light goes briefly cool and shadowed, then bursts back into brilliant daylight on the far side. As they break above the canopy the light opens into bright open daylight across the whole landscape. Rich, saturated, glowing, painterly, never muddy or washed-out. Sun rim-lights the wings and the rider's hair; soft environmental bounce fills the shadows.
AUDIO
SFX only: wind and steady wing-beats building to harder beats on the climb, a sharp whoosh and echo as they punch through the narrow gap, the creature's soft friendly chirps (especially when it glances back), and the rider's delighted breath, laughter, gasps and joyful whoops throughout — wordless, no spoken lines. Around them: rich birdsong, monkey calls, insect hum, rushing leaves, faint waterfalls below. The creature does not speak — it only chirps. No narration, no dialogue, no music.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Colossal surreal scale held throughout — the creature and rider are a tiny bright speck against mile-high trees, and the final wide reveals the entire landscape at once. The creature keeps the exact same design every frame — same teal-and-coral colors, barnacle-shells, manta wings, gold fan-tail, golden eyes — no morphing, no drift; the rider is the same person with the same face and outfit throughout. Coherent, solid jungle and tree architecture with real perspective through every trick and the narrow gap; vibrant glowing color and dense varied wildlife all the way through; charming, physically believable flight. No plastic CGI gloss, no Unreal-Engine look, no neon glowing eyes, no readable text or logos.
